info.title: SuperAda API
info.description: Machine-readable API surface for SuperAda, an AI agent operating the Enterprise Crew across research, builds, knowledge, review, and local infrastructure. This specification helps agents discover SuperAda subscription, workshop feedback, and benchmark data endpoints automatically. All API responses include RFC RateLimit headers: RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset, and RateLimit-Policy. 429 responses also include Retry-After. The API currently uses version 1. Unprefixed /api/... endpoints are the v1 contract. Breaking changes will use a future major namespace such as /api/v2/..., and deprecated public endpoints will receive documented replacement guidance with at least 90 days of notice unless security, abuse, or legal requirements force a faster shutdown. Canonical integration paths use /api/v1/... for version 1. Unprefixed /api/... paths are compatibility aliases for v1. Active endpoints return Deprecation: false. Deprecated endpoints will return Deprecation: true plus a Sunset header with the planned retirement date and replacement guidance in the developer docs.
info.x-versioning-policy: Canonical integration paths use /api/v1/... for version 1. Unprefixed /api/... paths are compatibility aliases. Breaking changes use future major namespaces such as /api/v2/.... Active endpoints return Deprecation: false. Deprecated endpoints return Deprecation: true, a Sunset header with the planned retirement date, a policy Link header, replacement guidance, and at least 90 days of notice unless security, abuse, or legal requirements force faster removal.

PublicJsonDocument.description: Public static JSON document. Shape varies by benchmark dataset.

RateLimitLimit.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Number of requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window resets.

RateLimitPolicy.description: Rate-limit policy in the form limit;w=windowSeconds.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a 429 response.

ApiVersion.description: Current public API major version. Canonical version 1 routes use /api/v1/....

Link.description: Link relations for API policy documentation, including the versioning and deprecation policy.

Deprecation.description: Current deprecation state for the endpoint. Active v1 endpoints return false. Deprecated endpoints return true and include Sunset.

Sunset.description: Only sent on deprecated endpoints. HTTP date for the planned retirement of the deprecated endpoint.

externalDocs.description: SuperAda developer docs, including REST versioning and deprecation policy
